results.title: Waldo by Wherobots: the AI agent for spatial data, from raw pixels to production data pipelines
results.content:
AI agents work well with text, documents, databases, and the internet. Physical-world data comes in rasters, point clouds, parcels, and road networks, and general-purpose agents get spatial relationships wrong. Waldo works across the full Wherobots stack, the AI Context Engine for Physical World Data, for data science, engineering, and production data pipelines. • Fuses the layers in WherobotsDB with spatial joins, drive-time isochrones, and nearest-neighbor search

• Scales on the same engine from one county to all 58 California counties
